Entic Haplorthod - Sandy loam soils at this site (about 54% sand, 33% silt, and 13% clay in the upper 30 cm) have developed from acidic, reddish, unsorted, coarse glacial till with 1040% rock fragments. Soils have been subjected to mixing by windthrows, burrowing animals and earthworm activity, and frost action. Mottling and saturated soils were observed between 50 and 100 cm below the surface at different times during the year in these somewhat poorly drained soils.
